e5_design_frozen_here.name: cross-scale functional alignment atlas, donor side
e5_design_frozen_here.measurement: final-prompt-token residual-stream states for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on the frozen calibration prompts, captured at matched RELATIVE depths (fractions 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00 of each donor's 36-layer stack, i.e. layers 0/9/18/27/35), one donor loaded at a time, CPU float32, streamed and released
e5_design_frozen_here.purpose: produce the depth x depth cross-scale similarity surface that neither v1 nor v2 ever measured, and determine whether 4B/8B agreement is stronger in function space than in raw parameter space

e6_design_frozen_here.name: low-rank functional translator
e6_design_frozen_here.measurement: fit A minimising ||z_0.6 - A z_donor||^2 on cached calibration activations at matched relative depth, with ridge, orthogonal Procrustes, and rank 4/8/16 variants
e6_design_frozen_here.fit_cost: a 1024 x 2560 (4B) or 1024 x 4096 (8B) least-squares solve on 59 samples per depth; CPU seconds, not LLM training
e6_design_frozen_here.purpose: decide whether a per-depth residual-stream basis correspondence exists at all. v1 fitted its only basis map on the vocabulary EMBEDDING matrices and applied it at every depth; held-out cosine was 0.335 (ridge) and 0.536/0.275 (Procrustes). No per-depth residual-stream map has ever been fitted.
e6_design_frozen_here.sample_size_caveat: 59 calibration prompts give 59 final-token samples per depth, which is far fewer than the 1024 target dimensions. The fit is rank-deficient unless it is restricted to low rank or extended to all token positions. E6 must therefore use all token positions, or an explicit low-rank constraint, and must report held-out error on a prompt-disjoint split. This is recorded before the experiment, not after.
